question: Which non-essential amino acid is synthesised by the hydroxylation of phenylalanine in a reaction catalysed by phenylalanine hydroxylase?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tyrosine**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Tyrosine** is the non-essential amino acid synthesized by the hydroxylation of phenylalanine.
 
• This reaction is catalyzed by the enzyme **phenylalanine hydroxylase**.
